verdict.rationale: Fireflies generates AI-driven meeting notes, action items, and customized summaries automatically (fireflies-docs-10), plus an AskFred AI assistant for querying meeting data and cross-meeting insights like comparing objections across prospect segments (fireflies-docs-18, fireflies-docs-24). These are in-product AI-generated insights/suggestions surfaced directly to users. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reviews validating quality of AskFred's insights, and more detail on the breadth/accuracy of automated suggestions beyond marketing copy.
